hints.title: Content Signature Grouping
hints.text: Files with identical content inside parentheses belong to the same duplicate group regardless of filename or directory.

hints.title: Full Path String Parsing
hints.text: Split each entry by spaces to separate directory path from files. For each file, extract the content inside parentheses as the grouping key.

hints.title: Bucket Filtering for Groups Greater than One
hints.text: Map content string to a list of full file paths dir/filename. Iterate through map values and return only groups containing two or more file paths.

hints.title: See the blueprint
hints.text:
```python
class Solution:
    def findDuplicate(self, paths: List[str]) -> List[List[str]]:
        from collections import defaultdict
        content_map = defaultdict(list)
        for path_entry in paths:
            parts = path_entry.split()
            dir_path = parts[0]
            for f in parts[1:]:
                name, content = f.split("(")
                content = content[:-1]
                content_map[content].append(f"{dir_path}/{name}")
        return [group for group in content_map.values() if len(group) > 1]
```

complexity.notes: Optimal solution achieving O(N * L) time and O(N * L) auxiliary space.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Pairwise file content comparisons require quadratic O(N^2 * L) operations.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Grouping paths by file content string in a dictionary achieves linear time in a single pass.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Candidate should filter out unique files (group size 1) and discuss real-world file hashing considerations.
